pages.setting: Pear orchard rooted along the edge of a broad cloud
pages.mainAction: A thundercrack scatters dozens of pears from the trees as the child and Leo stand beside their filled basket.
pages.lighting: Bright sunlit cloudscape split by a sudden lightning flash

pages.setting: Pear orchard rooted along the edge of a broad cloud
pages.mainAction: Leo sprawls to catch several escaping pears while one balances on his head before springing away, watched by the surprised child.
pages.lighting: Bright daylight with lingering storm glow

pages.setting: Empty blue sky with no clouds nearby
pages.mainAction: A small pear sprouts as mist forms soil beneath it, rain stretches into roots, and folded light becomes a golden branch.
pages.lighting: Cool blue openness with concentrated golden light around the sprout
continuityAnchors: escaped pear from the original orchard

pages.setting: New patch of mist-soil in the empty blue sky
pages.mainAction: The child helps Leo out of a mist heap after the springing golden branch flings him backward; three silver leaves now crown the sprout.
pages.lighting: Soft blue daylight with a warm glow on the branch

pages.mainAction: The child catches a plump drifting pear with both hands while tiny rootlets rustle beneath its skin.
pages.lighting: Airy daylight filtering through lace-like clouds
continuityAnchors: more pears drifting away from the original orchard

pages.mainAction: The child and Leo compare a soft yellow silent pear with a hard green pear whose seeds rattle inside.

pages.setting: Dark sea formed from towering waves of rain
pages.mainAction: Among rain waves and submerged drifting pears, the child ties the harvest basket to Leo's back before they begin sorting.
pages.lighting: Dark storm light punctuated by lightning flashes

pages.setting: Dark sea formed from towering waves of rain
pages.mainAction: The child tests pears by touch and sound while Leo sniffs one and accidentally catches a lightning-bright sensation with his nose.
pages.lighting: Cool rain-dark light with a close lightning flash
continuityAnchors: soft silent pears go into basket
hard rattling pears remain in the sky

pages.setting: Cool open field of stars beyond the rain sea
pages.mainAction: The child cups each of five nearly frozen pears while Leo warms them with small precise breaths.
pages.lighting: Cold starlight softened by small warm puffs

pages.setting: Cool open field of stars beyond the rain sea
pages.mainAction: Three opened pears grow into tiny flowering trees rooted in stardust as the child places the two softened pears into the basket.
pages.lighting: Cool starlight with luminous white blossoms

pages.setting: Pear orchard rooted along the edge of a broad cloud
pages.mainAction: An enormous storm cloud bears down as Leo hugs three bending trunks and the wind tangles his tail.
pages.lighting: Abruptly dark storm light filled with internal lightning
continuityAnchors: original pear trees rooted in mist

pages.setting: Storm-lashed canopy of the original cloud orchard
pages.mainAction: High in the canopy, the child checks one soft yellow pear for the basket and sends a green seed-rattling pear onward.

pages.setting: Storm-lashed canopy of the original cloud orchard
pages.mainAction: The child directs a ripe pear toward Leo's basket and a sprouting pear toward the open sky while branches swing around them.
pages.lighting: Storm-dark sky with sharp lightning highlights

pages.setting: Storm-lashed canopy of the original cloud orchard
pages.mainAction: After rapid sorting, the child carefully opens the final pear, revealing one sweet golden half and one green half holding a living seed.
pages.lighting: Rapid storm flashes focused on the opened pear
continuityAnchors: final pear golden on one side and green on the other

pages.setting: Open blue space between two distant sky orchards
pages.mainAction: Guided by the child, Leo blows the living seed into the empty blue space where mist, rain roots, light branches, and flowering vines connect the orchards.
pages.lighting: Clear blue radiance growing into a warm network glow
continuityAnchors: new orchard forming between existing orchards

pages.setting: Restored original orchard surrounded by connected sky gardens
pages.mainAction: With the storm gone, the child and Leo share a ripe pear beneath renewed branches while sky gardens bloom across the rain sea, star field, and former empty spaces.
pages.lighting: Calm golden daylight across softly glowing connected gardens
